sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Bainimarama ousts Qarase in military coup
geopolitical_news.summary: The military seized power in December, Fiji's fourth coup in two decades.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pacific neighbours condemn the takeover
geopolitical_news.summary: Australia and New Zealand imposed sanctions and travel bans on the military regime.

sport.headline: Fiji sevens side stays among world elite
sport.summary: The sevens team remained a crowd favourite and title contender on the world circuit.

geopolitical_news.headline: Interim regime expels Australian and NZ envoys
geopolitical_news.summary: Diplomatic expulsions deepened Fiji's isolation from its traditional Pacific partners.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bainimarama consolidates post-coup rule
geopolitical_news.summary: The military leader tightened control while promising elections at an unspecified date.

sport.headline: Fiji stuns Wales to reach World Cup quarter-final
sport.summary: A thrilling pool win in Nantes sent Fiji to the knockout stage in France.

geopolitical_news.headline: EU suspends sugar aid over coup
geopolitical_news.summary: Brussels cut assistance to Fiji's sugar industry, citing the failure to restore democracy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Regime expels New Zealand envoy again
geopolitical_news.summary: Fresh diplomatic expulsions kept tensions high with Wellington and Canberra.

sport.headline: Sevens team contends on IRB circuit
sport.summary: Fiji's sevens side challenged for titles across the world series legs.

geopolitical_news.headline: President abrogates constitution, sacks judiciary
geopolitical_news.summary: After courts ruled the coup illegal, Iloilo scrapped the constitution in April and reappointed Bainimarama.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji expelled from Forum, suspended by Commonwealth
geopolitical_news.summary: Pacific and Commonwealth bodies punished the regime for refusing an election timetable.

sport.headline: Fiji falls to Wales in Sevens World Cup final
sport.summary: Wales beat Fiji in the Dubai final to claim the 2009 sevens world title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bainimarama announces 2014 election roadmap
geopolitical_news.summary: The regime promised polls by September 2014 after years of delay.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji hosts 'Engaging the Pacific' meeting
geopolitical_news.summary: Suva gathered Pacific leaders outside the Forum framework it had been expelled from.

sport.headline: Fiji sevens remains a global drawcard
sport.summary: The team stayed among the world's best on the sevens circuit.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bainimarama promises 2014 polls at UN
geopolitical_news.summary: Addressing the General Assembly, the leader committed to elections within three years.

geopolitical_news.headline: Regime bans Methodist Church conference
geopolitical_news.summary: The annual church gathering was prohibited amid a crackdown on dissent.

sport.headline: Flying Fijians build toward World Cup
sport.summary: Fiji prepared for New Zealand 2011 with Pacific Nations Cup fixtures.

geopolitical_news.headline: Constitution commission begins work
geopolitical_news.summary: The Ghai-led commission started consulting Fijians on a new constitution.

geopolitical_news.headline: Police crack down on unions and media
geopolitical_news.summary: Emergency regulations were used against unionists and journalists critical of the regime.

sport.headline: Sevens team claims world series titles
sport.summary: Fiji won tournament legs on the IRB Sevens World Series.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bainimarama promulgates new constitution
geopolitical_news.summary: The September constitution replaced the abrogated 1997 document ahead of promised elections.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji re-engages Pacific via development forum
geopolitical_news.summary: Suva promoted its Pacific Islands Development Forum as a rival to the Forum.

sport.headline: Fiji qualifies for 2015 Rugby World Cup
sport.summary: The Flying Fijians secured their place at the England tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: FijiFirst wins first post-coup election
geopolitical_news.summary: Bainimarama's party won the September poll, Fiji's first democratic election in eight years.

geopolitical_news.headline: Commonwealth lifts Fiji's suspension
geopolitical_news.summary: The election was deemed credible enough to restore Fiji's membership.

sport.headline: Fiji sevens eyes Olympic debut
sport.summary: The sevens program targeted gold at rugby's return to the Olympics in Rio.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji champions climate action before Paris summit
geopolitical_news.summary: Suva pushed ocean and climate issues ahead of the COP21 negotiations.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government deepens 'Look North' diplomacy
geopolitical_news.summary: Fiji courted China and Russia as alternatives to Australia and New Zealand.

sport.headline: Flying Fijians exit World Cup in pool stage
sport.summary: Fiji beat Uruguay but lost to England, Australia and Wales in a brutal pool.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cyclone Winston devastates Fiji
geopolitical_news.summary: The February Category 5 storm, the strongest to hit the Southern Hemisphere, killed dozens.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bainimarama abandons flag-change plan
geopolitical_news.summary: The prime minister dropped the push for a new flag after public opposition.

sport.headline: Fiji wins first Olympic gold in rugby sevens
sport.summary: The men's team thrashed Britain in the Rio final to claim Fiji's maiden Olympic medal.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji presides over COP23 climate talks
geopolitical_news.summary: Bainimarama chaired the Bonn climate conference, a first for a Pacific island nation.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji elected to lead UN climate diplomacy
geopolitical_news.summary: Suva used the presidency to demand stronger action from major emitters.

sport.headline: Fiji sevens wins world series legs
sport.summary: The Olympic champions stayed dominant on the World Rugby Sevens Series.

geopolitical_news.headline: FijiFirst re-elected in November poll
geopolitical_news.summary: Bainimarama's party won a reduced majority in the general election.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji elected to UN Human Rights Council
geopolitical_news.summary: Suva won a seat on the council for the first time.

sport.headline: Fiji wins Hong Kong Sevens
sport.summary: The sevens team lifted the famous Hong Kong trophy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Measles outbreak prompts mass vaccination
geopolitical_news.summary: Fiji ran an emergency immunisation drive as measles spread through the Pacific.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji pushes ocean-climate agenda at UN
geopolitical_news.summary: Bainimarama championed blue economy and climate finance at global summits.

sport.headline: Fiji sevens chases world series glory
sport.summary: The team contended for the overall series title across the season's legs.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID closes borders; tourism collapses
geopolitical_news.summary: Fiji shut its borders, devastating the tourism industry that drives the economy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cyclone Yasa strikes in December
geopolitical_news.summary: The Category 5 storm tore through Vanua Levu, destroying villages and crops.

sport.headline: Olympic sevens defence put on hold
sport.summary: The Tokyo postponement delayed Fiji's bid to defend its rugby gold.

geopolitical_news.headline: Second COVID wave overwhelms hospitals
geopolitical_news.summary: The Delta variant swept Fiji mid-year after months of relative containment.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji reopens to tourists in December
geopolitical_news.summary: Vaccinated travellers returned as borders reopened to rescue the economy.

sport.headline: Fiji defends Olympic sevens gold in Tokyo
sport.summary: The men beat New Zealand in the final; Fijiana won a historic bronze.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rabuka's coalition ousts Bainimarama
geopolitical_news.summary: Sitiveni Rabuka formed a three-party coalition after the December election ended 16 years of Bainimarama rule.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji joins US Indo-Pacific Economic Framework
geopolitical_news.summary: Suva signed onto the American-led economic initiative.

sport.headline: Fiji wins Rugby World Cup Sevens
sport.summary: The men's team beat New Zealand in the Cape Town final.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rabuka restores Great Council of Chiefs
geopolitical_news.summary: The new government revived the chiefly body abolished after the 2006 coup.

geopolitical_news.headline: Media laws reviewed as press freedom returns
geopolitical_news.summary: The coalition moved to repeal draconian media legislation.

sport.headline: Fiji reaches Rugby World Cup quarter-final
sport.summary: The Flying Fijians made the knockouts in France before falling to England.

geopolitical_news.headline: Reconciliation commission process advances
geopolitical_news.summary: The government pushed a truth and reconciliation process for the coup era.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji deepens defence ties with Australia
geopolitical_news.summary: Suva and Canberra expanded security cooperation amid Pacific strategic competition.

sport.headline: Fiji men win Olympic sevens silver
sport.summary: France beat Fiji in the Paris final, ending the Olympic title defence.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rabuka pursues constitutional reform
geopolitical_news.summary: The prime minister pushed debate on amending the 2013 constitution amid coalition strains.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fiji navigates Pacific power rivalry
geopolitical_news.summary: Suva balanced ties with China, Australia and the US at regional summits.

sport.headline: Fiji sevens rebuilds for new cycle
sport.summary: The sevens programs regrouped after the Paris Olympics with new coaching setups.
